comparison.objective: Lock a fallen seesaw platform with a pin before placing two blocks; candidate screens media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Platform leveling, aligned safety-pin insertion and subsequent block placement versus controlled bulk loading and bimanual sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Pin locks all hinge layers before loading, blocks rest on marks, platform level and arms clear for 3 s; candidate requires media recovery and washer retention without spill.
comparison.reason: The central tested ability is safety interlocking before loading, not particulate separation.
